messages:
michael_csm: Heads up — Lyrical Inc (EU legal team) just signaled a new NLU squad that wants to go live next quarter. They expect to add a new conversational assistant for contract ingestion + Q&A. Could be a meaningful throughput bump.

sumi_cs: Nice, do we have rough numbers yet? Is this just embeddings or full gen + embeddings?

michael_csm: Both. Initial ask: realtime chat generation (~150 qps peak, ~40 rps sustained) + embeddings for search indexing (~1200 docs/day -> ~200 batch embed calls/day). They want <200ms median token latency and are sensitive to data residency (EU).

raj_engineer: @michael_csm curious which model family they prefer. If they need long-context summarization of contracts we'll likely pick a 32k variant which changes GPU footprint. Also: are they expecting streaming responses?

michael_csm: They prefer an open model we already host (rw-legal-2-small / rw-legal-2-medium family) but will run a short eval. Streaming yes. They flagged SLA concerns — if we can't guarantee region/EU data control + reasonable latency, they'll consider self-host or a competitor. Renewal in 9mo, so this is an expansion & risk play.

olivia_onboard: I can run a 1-hour enablement session for their engineering + legal ops next week. Recommend we share a short integration guide and a sample request payload.

raj_engineer: Sample payload helps. Quick example for our streaming chat API:```json
{
  "model": "rw-legal-2-medium",
  "input": "Summarize clause 3.2 and list obligations",
  "stream": true,
  "region": "eu-west-1"
}
```

michael_csm: Adding some business context — estimated committed spend if they go full-prod: $12k-$20k/mo depending on batching & quantization choices. If we propose a Dedicated pilot (1-2 nodes EU) that could lock them in and reduce churn risk.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New Dedicated-pilot request ticket created: #CS-8421 (assignee: eng-infra).

sumi_cs: Thanks. Action items: (1) @raj_engineer can you validate capacity and whether a 2-node Dedicated pilot would meet 150 qps peak with streaming? (2) @olivia_onboard set up enablement + send integration guide and security checklist (EU residency/KMS). (3) @michael_csm please collect a small eval prompt set (10 contracts) we can use for quality/regression checks.

michael_csm: On it — I'll gather evals and ask Lyrical for preferred SLA. Also will surface the potential renewal timing to AM.

raj_engineer: I'll run a quick perf estimate today and post numbers. If we need, we can propose a canary route: host gen in eu with fallback to a lower-cost variant in the same region for off-peak.

olivia_onboard: Tentatively scheduling enablement Tue 10am CET — inviting Lyrical devs. Will attach the onboarding checklist in the calendar invite.

michael_csm: Great, thanks all. This looks like a solid expansion opportunity + churn prevention if we act fast. :thumbsup:
